**Harrisburg University of Science & Technology**, commonly referred to as **Harrisburg University** (**HU**), is a [private](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Private_university "Private university")[STEM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Science,_technology,_engineering,_and_mathematics "Science, technology, engineering, and mathematics")-focused university in [Harrisburg, Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg,_Pennsylvania "Harrisburg, Pennsylvania"), with an additional location in [Philadelphia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philadelphia "Philadelphia"). Founded in 2001 as Harrisburg Polytechnic Institute, it offers [STEM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Science,_technology,_engineering,_and_mathematics "Science, technology, engineering, and mathematics")-focused degree and certificate programs.

Harrisburg University places special emphasis on education in fields related to engineering, applied science and technology and offers 15 [bachelor's degrees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bachelor's_degree "Bachelor's degree"), 13 [master's degrees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Master's_degrees "Master's degrees"), and 3 [doctoral degrees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doctoral_degrees "Doctoral degrees") and certificate programs. The university is accredited by the [Middle States Commission on Higher Education](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Middle_States_Commission_on_Higher_Education "Middle States Commission on Higher Education").[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-msche-8)

## History

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: History")]

The university was started as Harrisburg [Polytechnic Institute](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Institute_of_technology "Institute of technology") to address the [Harrisburg, Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg,_Pennsylvania "Harrisburg, Pennsylvania"), region's need for educational opportunities in science, technology, engineering, and math careers. Before creation of Harrisburg University of Science and Technology, Harrisburg was the largest state capital in the country without a four-year university. The institute received $12 million in state capital funding in 2003 for the construction and related services of the institute from then [Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania "Pennsylvania")[Governor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor "Governor")[Ed Rendell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ed_Rendell "Ed Rendell").[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-tenyr-9) The [YWCA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YWCA "YWCA") building at 215 Market Street was the first home for the university. In the same year the university changed its name to Harrisburg University of Science and Technology.

Harrisburg University has many research centers, including the Center for Advanced Entertainment and Learning Technologies, the Security Center of Excellence, the Government Technology Institute, the Center for Advanced Agriculture and Sustainability, and the Center for Innovation and Entrepreneurship.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-10)

In 2023, the university downsized employees due to a budget shortfall.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-11) In May 2024, the university missed a bond payment, signifying a cash flow crunch.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-12) A second round of layoffs took place in June 2024.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-13) In July 2024, the university closed its locations in Dubai and Panama.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-14)

In May 2020, a team of two Harrisburg University professors and a Ph.D. student announced they had developed computer [facial recognition](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Facial_recognition_system "Facial recognition system") software capable of [predicting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Predictive_policing "Predictive policing") whether someone is likely to be a criminal based solely on a photo of their face, and "with no racial bias",[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-15) a claim found dubious by critics.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-16) The announcement was criticized as being "21st-century [phrenology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phrenology "Phrenology")"[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-17) and going "way further than the [pseudoscience](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pseudoscience "Pseudoscience") of [physiognomy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Physiognomy "Physiognomy")."[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-18) The university later deleted the press release at the request of the researchers involved,[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-19) noting that they are "updating the paper to address concerns raised."[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-20)

Four years later, Harrisburg University leaders announced that the university had been designated by the [National Security Agency](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Security_Agency "National Security Agency") (NSA) as a Center of Academic Excellence in Cyber Defense (CAE-CD).[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-:0-21) According to a university press release, “schools seeking to become NSA-approved CAE institutions undergo an extensive program validation process; prove relevant courses map to NSA requirements, objectives, and priorities; and meet high academic standards.”[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-:0-21) Harrisburg University's Master of Science in Computer Information Sciences[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-22) served as the NSA’s validated program of study. The university also offers a Bachelor of Science[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-23) and Master of Science[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-24) in Cybersecurity Operations & Control Management.

## Campus

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Campus")]

[![Image 9](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/01/4th_Street_towards_Pennsylvania_State_Capitol_Building%2C_Harrisburg%2C_PA_-_52441723198.jpg/250px-4th_Street_towards_Pennsylvania_State_Capitol_Building%2C_Harrisburg%2C_PA_-_52441723198.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:4th_Street_towards_Pennsylvania_State_Capitol_Building,_Harrisburg,_PA_-_52441723198.jpg)

The [Pennsylvania State Capitol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania_State_Capitol "Pennsylvania State Capitol") as seen from Harrisburg University campus

The university's 371,000-[square-foot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Square_foot "Square foot") Academic Center is a 16-story building in downtown Harrisburg, 326 Market St. The building includes classrooms, science labs, meeting areas, seminar rooms, a 125-seat auditorium and a courtyard. The academic center has wireless internet, video conferencing and a multi-media production facility.[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-25) It also has seven levels of parking between the ground floor and the academic floors.[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-26)

In 2017, the university opened a [satellite](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satellite_campus "Satellite campus") location in [Philadelphia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philadelphia "Philadelphia").[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-phillyloc-27) The Philadelphia location offers bachelor's degree programs in Computer and Information Science, Esports Management, Information Systems and Information Technologies, Management and Entrepreneurship, and Interactive Media and also master's courses in Techpreneurship.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-phillyprog-28)

In 2022, the university opened a location in the City of Knowledge in Panama.[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-29) Additionally, the university constructed a $100-million Science Education Center at 3rd and Chestnut in Harrisburg. The 12-story UPMC Health Sciences Tower was dedicated on September 13, 2023.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-30)[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-31)

## Academics

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Academics")]

Harrisburg University has 15 [undergraduate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Undergraduate "Undergraduate"),[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-harrisburgu-ug-32) 13 [master's](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Master's_degree "Master's degree")[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-harrisburgu-grad-33) and three [doctoral](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doctorate "Doctorate") programs[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-harrisburgu-grad-33) in science and technology-related disciplines. The university follows a trimester system. Programs are offered at the academic center located on the main campus in downtown Harrisburg. Some programs are also offered at the Harrisburg University location in Philadelphia, while others are offered only online. The [Philadelphia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philadelphia "Philadelphia") location offers bachelor's courses in Computer and Information Science, Esports Management, Information Systems and Information Technologies, Management and Entrepreneurship, and Interactive Media; and master's courses in Techpreneurship. The university offers online degree programs, including an RN-to-BSN.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-phillyprog-28)

### Accreditations

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Accreditations")]

Harrisburg University of Science and Technology is accredited by the [Middle States Commission on Higher Education](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Middle_States_Commission_on_Higher_Education "Middle States Commission on Higher Education") since 2009.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-msche-8) All Bachelors, Masters and Doctoral (Research) degrees are accredited.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-msche-8) In 2014, the commission placed the university on probation for failing to comply with its standards.[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-34) In March, 2016, the commission determined that the school was in compliance and reaffirmed accreditation until 2021.[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-35) In 2022, the university accreditation was re-affirmed through 2029.[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-36)

The university is also approved by the [Pennsylvania Department of Education](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania_Department_of_Education "Pennsylvania Department of Education") Bureau of Postsecondary and Adult Education.[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-37) The MS in Project Management is accredited by the Global Accreditation Center from the Project Management Institute. The B.S. in Computer and Information Science program is accredited by ABET. The RN-BSN and MS in Nursing programs are accredited by the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE).[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-38)

## Student life

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section: Student life")]

The university's housing is located close to campus in [downtown Harrisburg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Downtown_Harrisburg,_Pennsylvania "Downtown Harrisburg, Pennsylvania"). Housing is offered to undergraduate students and consists of the Residences on Market and Market View Place.[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-43) The university is located near the [Whitaker Center for Science and the Arts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Whitaker_Center_for_Science_and_the_Arts "Whitaker Center for Science and the Arts"), and the [State Museum of Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/State_Museum_of_Pennsylvania "State Museum of Pennsylvania"). The university is also a half block from the [state capitol of Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania_State_Capitol "Pennsylvania State Capitol"), and a brief walk to the [Riverfront Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Riverfront_Park_(Harrisburg) "Riverfront Park (Harrisburg)") along the [Susquehanna River](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Susquehanna_River "Susquehanna River"). Fitness and dining facilities are leveraged by [Strawberry Square](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strawberry_Square "Strawberry Square"). In 2017, the university opened a [satellite location](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satellite_campus "Satellite campus") in Philadelphia.[[44]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-44)

The university fields an [esports](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esports "Esports") varsity team that has won two national championships.[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-45)[[46]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-46)

**Harrisburg University of Science & Technology**, commonly referred to as **Harrisburg University** (**HU**), is a [private](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Private_university "Private university")[STEM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Science,_technology,_engineering,_and_mathematics "Science, technology, engineering, and mathematics")-focused university in [Harrisburg, Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg,_Pennsylvania "Harrisburg, Pennsylvania"), with an additional location in [Philadelphia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philadelphia "Philadelphia"). Founded in 2001 as Harrisburg Polytechnic Institute, it offers [STEM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Science,_technology,_engineering,_and_mathematics "Science, technology, engineering, and mathematics")-focused degree and certificate programs.

Harrisburg University places special emphasis on education in fields related to engineering, applied science and technology and offers 15 [bachelor's degrees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bachelor's_degree "Bachelor's degree"), 13 [master's degrees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Master's_degrees "Master's degrees"), and 3 [doctoral degrees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doctoral_degrees "Doctoral degrees") and certificate programs. The university is accredited by the [Middle States Commission on Higher Education](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Middle_States_Commission_on_Higher_Education "Middle States Commission on Higher Education").[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-msche-8)

## History

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: History")]

The university was started as Harrisburg [Polytechnic Institute](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Institute_of_technology "Institute of technology") to address the [Harrisburg, Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg,_Pennsylvania "Harrisburg, Pennsylvania"), region's need for educational opportunities in science, technology, engineering, and math careers. Before creation of Harrisburg University of Science and Technology, Harrisburg was the largest state capital in the country without a four-year university. The institute received $12 million in state capital funding in 2003 for the construction and related services of the institute from then [Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania "Pennsylvania")[Governor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor "Governor")[Ed Rendell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ed_Rendell "Ed Rendell").[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-tenyr-9) The [YWCA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YWCA "YWCA") building at 215 Market Street was the first home for the university. In the same year the university changed its name to Harrisburg University of Science and Technology.

Harrisburg University has many research centers, including the Center for Advanced Entertainment and Learning Technologies, the Security Center of Excellence, the Government Technology Institute, the Center for Advanced Agriculture and Sustainability, and the Center for Innovation and Entrepreneurship.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-10)

In 2023, the university downsized employees due to a budget shortfall.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-11) In May 2024, the university missed a bond payment, signifying a cash flow crunch.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-12) A second round of layoffs took place in June 2024.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-13) In July 2024, the university closed its locations in Dubai and Panama.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-14)

In May 2020, a team of two Harrisburg University professors and a Ph.D. student announced they had developed computer [facial recognition](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Facial_recognition_system "Facial recognition system") software capable of [predicting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Predictive_policing "Predictive policing") whether someone is likely to be a criminal based solely on a photo of their face, and "with no racial bias",[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-15) a claim found dubious by critics.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-16) The announcement was criticized as being "21st-century [phrenology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phrenology "Phrenology")"[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-17) and going "way further than the [pseudoscience](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pseudoscience "Pseudoscience") of [physiognomy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Physiognomy "Physiognomy")."[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-18) The university later deleted the press release at the request of the researchers involved,[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-19) noting that they are "updating the paper to address concerns raised."[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-20)

Four years later, Harrisburg University leaders announced that the university had been designated by the [National Security Agency](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Security_Agency "National Security Agency") (NSA) as a Center of Academic Excellence in Cyber Defense (CAE-CD).[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-:0-21) According to a university press release, “schools seeking to become NSA-approved CAE institutions undergo an extensive program validation process; prove relevant courses map to NSA requirements, objectives, and priorities; and meet high academic standards.”[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-:0-21) Harrisburg University's Master of Science in Computer Information Sciences[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-22) served as the NSA’s validated program of study. The university also offers a Bachelor of Science[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-23) and Master of Science[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-24) in Cybersecurity Operations & Control Management.

The university's 371,000-[square-foot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Square_foot "Square foot") Academic Center is a 16-story building in downtown Harrisburg, 326 Market St. The building includes classrooms, science labs, meeting areas, seminar rooms, a 125-seat auditorium and a courtyard. The academic center has wireless internet, video conferencing and a multi-media production facility.[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-25) It also has seven levels of parking between the ground floor and the academic floors.[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-26)

In 2017, the university opened a [satellite](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satellite_campus "Satellite campus") location in [Philadelphia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philadelphia "Philadelphia").[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-phillyloc-27) The Philadelphia location offers bachelor's degree programs in Computer and Information Science, Esports Management, Information Systems and Information Technologies, Management and Entrepreneurship, and Interactive Media and also master's courses in Techpreneurship.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-phillyprog-28)

In 2022, the university opened a location in the City of Knowledge in Panama.[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-29) Additionally, the university constructed a $100-million Science Education Center at 3rd and Chestnut in Harrisburg. The 12-story UPMC Health Sciences Tower was dedicated on September 13, 2023.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-30)[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-31)

## Academics

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Academics")]

Harrisburg University has 15 [undergraduate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Undergraduate "Undergraduate"),[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-harrisburgu-ug-32) 13 [master's](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Master's_degree "Master's degree")[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-harrisburgu-grad-33) and three [doctoral](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doctorate "Doctorate") programs[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-harrisburgu-grad-33) in science and technology-related disciplines. The university follows a trimester system. Programs are offered at the academic center located on the main campus in downtown Harrisburg. Some programs are also offered at the Harrisburg University location in Philadelphia, while others are offered only online. The [Philadelphia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philadelphia "Philadelphia") location offers bachelor's courses in Computer and Information Science, Esports Management, Information Systems and Information Technologies, Management and Entrepreneurship, and Interactive Media; and master's courses in Techpreneurship. The university offers online degree programs, including an RN-to-BSN.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-phillyprog-28)

### Accreditations

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Accreditations")]

Harrisburg University of Science and Technology is accredited by the [Middle States Commission on Higher Education](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Middle_States_Commission_on_Higher_Education "Middle States Commission on Higher Education") since 2009.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-msche-8) All Bachelors, Masters and Doctoral (Research) degrees are accredited.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-msche-8) In 2014, the commission placed the university on probation for failing to comply with its standards.[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-34) In March, 2016, the commission determined that the school was in compliance and reaffirmed accreditation until 2021.[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-35) In 2022, the university accreditation was re-affirmed through 2029.[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-36)

The university is also approved by the [Pennsylvania Department of Education](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania_Department_of_Education "Pennsylvania Department of Education") Bureau of Postsecondary and Adult Education.[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-37) The MS in Project Management is accredited by the Global Accreditation Center from the Project Management Institute. The B.S. in Computer and Information Science program is accredited by ABET. The RN-BSN and MS in Nursing programs are accredited by the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE).[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-38)

## Student life

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section: Student life")]

The university's housing is located close to campus in [downtown Harrisburg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Downtown_Harrisburg,_Pennsylvania "Downtown Harrisburg, Pennsylvania"). Housing is offered to undergraduate students and consists of the Residences on Market and Market View Place.[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-43) The university is located near the [Whitaker Center for Science and the Arts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Whitaker_Center_for_Science_and_the_Arts "Whitaker Center for Science and the Arts"), and the [State Museum of Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/State_Museum_of_Pennsylvania "State Museum of Pennsylvania"). The university is also a half block from the [state capitol of Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania_State_Capitol "Pennsylvania State Capitol"), and a brief walk to the [Riverfront Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Riverfront_Park_(Harrisburg) "Riverfront Park (Harrisburg)") along the [Susquehanna River](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Susquehanna_River "Susquehanna River"). Fitness and dining facilities are leveraged by [Strawberry Square](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strawberry_Square "Strawberry Square"). In 2017, the university opened a [satellite location](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satellite_campus "Satellite campus") in Philadelphia.[[44]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-44)

The university fields an [esports](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esports "Esports") varsity team that has won two national championships.[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-45)[[46]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology#cite_note-46)

**Harrisburg University of Science & Technology**, commonly referred to as **Harrisburg University** (**HU**), is a [private](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Private_university "Private university")[STEM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Science,_technology,_engineering,_and_mathematics "Science, technology, engineering, and mathematics")-focused university in [Harrisburg, Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg,_Pennsylvania "Harrisburg, Pennsylvania"), with an additional location in [Philadelphia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philadelphia "Philadelphia"). Founded in 2001 as Harrisburg Polytechnic Institute, it offers [STEM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Science,_technology,_engineering,_and_mathematics "Science, technology, engineering, and mathematics")-focused degree and certificate programs.

Harrisburg University places special emphasis on education in fields related to engineering, applied science and technology and offers 15 [bachelor's degrees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bachelor's_degree "Bachelor's degree"), 13 [master's degrees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Master's_degrees "Master's degrees"), and 3 [doctoral degrees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doctoral_degrees "Doctoral degrees") and certificate programs. The university is accredited by the [Middle States Commission on Higher Education](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Middle_States_Commission_on_Higher_Education "Middle States Commission on Higher Education").[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-msche-8)

## History

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: History")]

The university was started as Harrisburg [Polytechnic Institute](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Institute_of_technology "Institute of technology") to address the [Harrisburg, Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg,_Pennsylvania "Harrisburg, Pennsylvania"), region's need for educational opportunities in science, technology, engineering, and math careers. Before creation of Harrisburg University of Science and Technology, Harrisburg was the largest state capital in the country without a four-year university. The institute received $12 million in state capital funding in 2003 for the construction and related services of the institute from then [Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania "Pennsylvania")[Governor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor "Governor")[Ed Rendell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ed_Rendell "Ed Rendell").[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-tenyr-9) The [YWCA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YWCA "YWCA") building at 215 Market Street was the first home for the university. In the same year the university changed its name to Harrisburg University of Science and Technology.

Harrisburg University has many research centers, including the Center for Advanced Entertainment and Learning Technologies, the Security Center of Excellence, the Government Technology Institute, the Center for Advanced Agriculture and Sustainability, and the Center for Innovation and Entrepreneurship.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-10)

In 2023, the university downsized employees due to a budget shortfall.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-11) In May 2024, the university missed a bond payment, signifying a cash flow crunch.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-12) A second round of layoffs took place in June 2024.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-13) In July 2024, the university closed its locations in Dubai and Panama.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-14)

In May 2020, a team of two Harrisburg University professors and a Ph.D. student announced they had developed computer [facial recognition](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Facial_recognition_system "Facial recognition system") software capable of [predicting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Predictive_policing "Predictive policing") whether someone is likely to be a criminal based solely on a photo of their face, and "with no racial bias",[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-15) a claim found dubious by critics.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-16) The announcement was criticized as being "21st-century [phrenology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phrenology "Phrenology")"[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-17) and going "way further than the [pseudoscience](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pseudoscience "Pseudoscience") of [physiognomy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Physiognomy "Physiognomy")."[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-18) The university later deleted the press release at the request of the researchers involved,[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-19) noting that they are "updating the paper to address concerns raised."[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-20)

Four years later, Harrisburg University leaders announced that the university had been designated by the [National Security Agency](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Security_Agency "National Security Agency") (NSA) as a Center of Academic Excellence in Cyber Defense (CAE-CD).[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-:0-21) According to a university press release, “schools seeking to become NSA-approved CAE institutions undergo an extensive program validation process; prove relevant courses map to NSA requirements, objectives, and priorities; and meet high academic standards.”[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-:0-21) Harrisburg University's Master of Science in Computer Information Sciences[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-22) served as the NSA’s validated program of study. The university also offers a Bachelor of Science[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-23) and Master of Science[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-24) in Cybersecurity Operations & Control Management.

## Campus

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Campus")]

[![Image 7](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/01/4th_Street_towards_Pennsylvania_State_Capitol_Building%2C_Harrisburg%2C_PA_-_52441723198.jpg/250px-4th_Street_towards_Pennsylvania_State_Capitol_Building%2C_Harrisburg%2C_PA_-_52441723198.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:4th_Street_towards_Pennsylvania_State_Capitol_Building,_Harrisburg,_PA_-_52441723198.jpg)

The [Pennsylvania State Capitol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania_State_Capitol "Pennsylvania State Capitol") as seen from Harrisburg University campus

The university's 371,000-[square-foot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Square_foot "Square foot") Academic Center is a 16-story building in downtown Harrisburg, 326 Market St. The building includes classrooms, science labs, meeting areas, seminar rooms, a 125-seat auditorium and a courtyard. The academic center has wireless internet, video conferencing and a multi-media production facility.[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-25) It also has seven levels of parking between the ground floor and the academic floors.[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-26)

In 2017, the university opened a [satellite](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satellite_campus "Satellite campus") location in [Philadelphia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philadelphia "Philadelphia").[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-phillyloc-27) The Philadelphia location offers bachelor's degree programs in Computer and Information Science, Esports Management, Information Systems and Information Technologies, Management and Entrepreneurship, and Interactive Media and also master's courses in Techpreneurship.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-phillyprog-28)

In 2022, the university opened a location in the City of Knowledge in Panama.[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-29) Additionally, the university constructed a $100-million Science Education Center at 3rd and Chestnut in Harrisburg. The 12-story UPMC Health Sciences Tower was dedicated on September 13, 2023.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-30)[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-31)

## Academics

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Academics")]

Harrisburg University has 15 [undergraduate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Undergraduate "Undergraduate"),[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-harrisburgu-ug-32) 13 [master's](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Master's_degree "Master's degree")[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-harrisburgu-grad-33) and three [doctoral](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doctorate "Doctorate") programs[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-harrisburgu-grad-33) in science and technology-related disciplines. The university follows a trimester system. Programs are offered at the academic center located on the main campus in downtown Harrisburg. Some programs are also offered at the Harrisburg University location in Philadelphia, while others are offered only online. The [Philadelphia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philadelphia "Philadelphia") location offers bachelor's courses in Computer and Information Science, Esports Management, Information Systems and Information Technologies, Management and Entrepreneurship, and Interactive Media; and master's courses in Techpreneurship. The university offers online degree programs, including an RN-to-BSN.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-phillyprog-28)

### Accreditations

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Accreditations")]

Harrisburg University of Science and Technology is accredited by the [Middle States Commission on Higher Education](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Middle_States_Commission_on_Higher_Education "Middle States Commission on Higher Education") since 2009.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-msche-8) All Bachelors, Masters and Doctoral (Research) degrees are accredited.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-msche-8) In 2014, the commission placed the university on probation for failing to comply with its standards.[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-34) In March, 2016, the commission determined that the school was in compliance and reaffirmed accreditation until 2021.[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-35) In 2022, the university accreditation was re-affirmed through 2029.[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-36)

The university is also approved by the [Pennsylvania Department of Education](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania_Department_of_Education "Pennsylvania Department of Education") Bureau of Postsecondary and Adult Education.[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-37) The MS in Project Management is accredited by the Global Accreditation Center from the Project Management Institute. The B.S. in Computer and Information Science program is accredited by ABET. The RN-BSN and MS in Nursing programs are accredited by the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE).[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-38)

## Student life

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section: Student life")]

The university's housing is located close to campus in [downtown Harrisburg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Downtown_Harrisburg,_Pennsylvania "Downtown Harrisburg, Pennsylvania"). Housing is offered to undergraduate students and consists of the Residences on Market and Market View Place.[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-43) The university is located near the [Whitaker Center for Science and the Arts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Whitaker_Center_for_Science_and_the_Arts "Whitaker Center for Science and the Arts"), and the [State Museum of Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/State_Museum_of_Pennsylvania "State Museum of Pennsylvania"). The university is also a half block from the [state capitol of Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania_State_Capitol "Pennsylvania State Capitol"), and a brief walk to the [Riverfront Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Riverfront_Park_(Harrisburg) "Riverfront Park (Harrisburg)") along the [Susquehanna River](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Susquehanna_River "Susquehanna River"). Fitness and dining facilities are leveraged by [Strawberry Square](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strawberry_Square "Strawberry Square"). In 2017, the university opened a [satellite location](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satellite_campus "Satellite campus") in Philadelphia.[[44]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-44)

The university fields an [esports](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esports "Esports") varsity team that has won two national championships.[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-45)[[46]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-46)

**Harrisburg University of Science & Technology**, commonly referred to as **Harrisburg University** (**HU**), is a [private](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Private_university "Private university")[STEM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Science,_technology,_engineering,_and_mathematics "Science, technology, engineering, and mathematics")-focused university in [Harrisburg, Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg,_Pennsylvania "Harrisburg, Pennsylvania"), with an additional location in [Philadelphia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philadelphia "Philadelphia"). Founded in 2001 as Harrisburg Polytechnic Institute, it offers [STEM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Science,_technology,_engineering,_and_mathematics "Science, technology, engineering, and mathematics")-focused degree and certificate programs.

Harrisburg University places special emphasis on education in fields related to engineering, applied science and technology and offers 15 [bachelor's degrees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bachelor's_degree "Bachelor's degree"), 13 [master's degrees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Master's_degrees "Master's degrees"), and 3 [doctoral degrees](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doctoral_degrees "Doctoral degrees") and certificate programs. The university is accredited by the [Middle States Commission on Higher Education](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Middle_States_Commission_on_Higher_Education "Middle States Commission on Higher Education").[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-msche-8)

## History

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: History")]

The university was started as Harrisburg [Polytechnic Institute](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Institute_of_technology "Institute of technology") to address the [Harrisburg, Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrisburg,_Pennsylvania "Harrisburg, Pennsylvania"), region's need for educational opportunities in science, technology, engineering, and math careers. Before creation of Harrisburg University of Science and Technology, Harrisburg was the largest state capital in the country without a four-year university. The institute received $12 million in state capital funding in 2003 for the construction and related services of the institute from then [Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania "Pennsylvania")[Governor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Governor "Governor")[Ed Rendell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ed_Rendell "Ed Rendell").[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-tenyr-9) The [YWCA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YWCA "YWCA") building at 215 Market Street was the first home for the university. In the same year the university changed its name to Harrisburg University of Science and Technology.

Harrisburg University has many research centers, including the Center for Advanced Entertainment and Learning Technologies, the Security Center of Excellence, the Government Technology Institute, the Center for Advanced Agriculture and Sustainability, and the Center for Innovation and Entrepreneurship.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-10)

In 2023, the university downsized employees due to a budget shortfall.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-11) In May 2024, the university missed a bond payment, signifying a cash flow crunch.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-12) A second round of layoffs took place in June 2024.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-13) In July 2024, the university closed its locations in Dubai and Panama.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-14)

In May 2020, a team of two Harrisburg University professors and a Ph.D. student announced they had developed computer [facial recognition](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Facial_recognition_system "Facial recognition system") software capable of [predicting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Predictive_policing "Predictive policing") whether someone is likely to be a criminal based solely on a photo of their face, and "with no racial bias",[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-15) a claim found dubious by critics.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-16) The announcement was criticized as being "21st-century [phrenology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phrenology "Phrenology")"[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-17) and going "way further than the [pseudoscience](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pseudoscience "Pseudoscience") of [physiognomy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Physiognomy "Physiognomy")."[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-18) The university later deleted the press release at the request of the researchers involved,[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-19) noting that they are "updating the paper to address concerns raised."[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-20)

Four years later, Harrisburg University leaders announced that the university had been designated by the [National Security Agency](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Security_Agency "National Security Agency") (NSA) as a Center of Academic Excellence in Cyber Defense (CAE-CD).[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-:0-21) According to a university press release, “schools seeking to become NSA-approved CAE institutions undergo an extensive program validation process; prove relevant courses map to NSA requirements, objectives, and priorities; and meet high academic standards.”[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-:0-21) Harrisburg University's Master of Science in Computer Information Sciences[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-22) served as the NSA’s validated program of study. The university also offers a Bachelor of Science[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-23) and Master of Science[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-24) in Cybersecurity Operations & Control Management.

## Campus

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Campus")]

[![Image 7](https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/01/4th_Street_towards_Pennsylvania_State_Capitol_Building%2C_Harrisburg%2C_PA_-_52441723198.jpg/250px-4th_Street_towards_Pennsylvania_State_Capitol_Building%2C_Harrisburg%2C_PA_-_52441723198.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:4th_Street_towards_Pennsylvania_State_Capitol_Building,_Harrisburg,_PA_-_52441723198.jpg)

The [Pennsylvania State Capitol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania_State_Capitol "Pennsylvania State Capitol") as seen from Harrisburg University campus

The university's 371,000-[square-foot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Square_foot "Square foot") Academic Center is a 16-story building in downtown Harrisburg, 326 Market St. The building includes classrooms, science labs, meeting areas, seminar rooms, a 125-seat auditorium and a courtyard. The academic center has wireless internet, video conferencing and a multi-media production facility.[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-25) It also has seven levels of parking between the ground floor and the academic floors.[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-26)

In 2017, the university opened a [satellite](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satellite_campus "Satellite campus") location in [Philadelphia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philadelphia "Philadelphia").[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-phillyloc-27) The Philadelphia location offers bachelor's degree programs in Computer and Information Science, Esports Management, Information Systems and Information Technologies, Management and Entrepreneurship, and Interactive Media and also master's courses in Techpreneurship.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-phillyprog-28)

In 2022, the university opened a location in the City of Knowledge in Panama.[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-29) Additionally, the university constructed a $100-million Science Education Center at 3rd and Chestnut in Harrisburg. The 12-story UPMC Health Sciences Tower was dedicated on September 13, 2023.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-30)[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-31)

## Academics

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Academics")]

Harrisburg University has 15 [undergraduate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Undergraduate "Undergraduate"),[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-harrisburgu-ug-32) 13 [master's](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Master's_degree "Master's degree")[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-harrisburgu-grad-33) and three [doctoral](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doctorate "Doctorate") programs[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-harrisburgu-grad-33) in science and technology-related disciplines. The university follows a trimester system. Programs are offered at the academic center located on the main campus in downtown Harrisburg. Some programs are also offered at the Harrisburg University location in Philadelphia, while others are offered only online. The [Philadelphia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philadelphia "Philadelphia") location offers bachelor's courses in Computer and Information Science, Esports Management, Information Systems and Information Technologies, Management and Entrepreneurship, and Interactive Media; and master's courses in Techpreneurship. The university offers online degree programs, including an RN-to-BSN.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-phillyprog-28)

### Accreditations

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: Accreditations")]

Harrisburg University of Science and Technology is accredited by the [Middle States Commission on Higher Education](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Middle_States_Commission_on_Higher_Education "Middle States Commission on Higher Education") since 2009.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-msche-8) All Bachelors, Masters and Doctoral (Research) degrees are accredited.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-msche-8) In 2014, the commission placed the university on probation for failing to comply with its standards.[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-34) In March, 2016, the commission determined that the school was in compliance and reaffirmed accreditation until 2021.[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-35) In 2022, the university accreditation was re-affirmed through 2029.[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-36)

The university is also approved by the [Pennsylvania Department of Education](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania_Department_of_Education "Pennsylvania Department of Education") Bureau of Postsecondary and Adult Education.[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-37) The MS in Project Management is accredited by the Global Accreditation Center from the Project Management Institute. The B.S. in Computer and Information Science program is accredited by ABET. The RN-BSN and MS in Nursing programs are accredited by the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE).[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-38)

## Student life

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section: Student life")]

The university's housing is located close to campus in [downtown Harrisburg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Downtown_Harrisburg,_Pennsylvania "Downtown Harrisburg, Pennsylvania"). Housing is offered to undergraduate students and consists of the Residences on Market and Market View Place.[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-43) The university is located near the [Whitaker Center for Science and the Arts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Whitaker_Center_for_Science_and_the_Arts "Whitaker Center for Science and the Arts"), and the [State Museum of Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/State_Museum_of_Pennsylvania "State Museum of Pennsylvania"). The university is also a half block from the [state capitol of Pennsylvania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pennsylvania_State_Capitol "Pennsylvania State Capitol"), and a brief walk to the [Riverfront Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Riverfront_Park_(Harrisburg) "Riverfront Park (Harrisburg)") along the [Susquehanna River](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Susquehanna_River "Susquehanna River"). Fitness and dining facilities are leveraged by [Strawberry Square](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Strawberry_Square "Strawberry Square"). In 2017, the university opened a [satellite location](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satellite_campus "Satellite campus") in Philadelphia.[[44]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-44)

The university fields an [esports](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esports "Esports") varsity team that has won two national championships.[[45]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-45)[[46]](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Harrisburg_University_of_Science_and_Technology&search=Founder&limit=200#cite_note-46)

Reasoning: medium
Read pages for a research assistant and follow useful links recursively. During
extraction, only the supplied page is evidence. The question defines what to look
for; parent reasoning guides navigation but is not this page's evidence.
Extraction uses the original question and current page, not the search query or
parent's hypothesis. Keep facts relevant to any part of the original question.
During navigation, a supplied local relation is a task, not evidence. Follow links
that establish or contradict it. Return when it is settled or has no useful route
here; other unresolved relations belong to the parent. Do not solve the whole
question again inside every branch.

Preserve exact relevant names and rows with their headers, values, units, dates
and scope. Never replace relevant rows with ellipses, examples or instructions to
continue the list. If all rows cannot fit, prioritize rows useful to the question
and explicitly mark omissions. A partial, restricted or truncated list is not the
complete candidate set. Missing fields are unknown. Keep relevant discoveries even
if they answer a different part of the original question.

Follow links likely to fill a candidate's missing condition or reach the required
document/year. An index is useful when it offers a concrete route to the needed
record; generic menus or keyword collections alone do not justify expansion.
Link-menu rank is only a hint: check the destination's subject and scope. If content
repeats, try a detail page or another supported route. Links outside the menu and inferred
paths on an observed site are allowed. Child notes are returned automatically;
do not copy their facts into your own note. Retain useful unvisited links even
when expansion stops.

For extraction return:
**Final Information**
**Page:** Actual title and URL.
**Evidence:** Exact relevant facts/rows and short supporting quotes.
**Connections:** Candidate and identifying relation supported or contradicted here; label deductions.
**Coverage:** Actual entities, years, population; full list, subset or excerpt.
**Missing:** Requested fields this page does not establish.
**Next links:** One URL and missing relation per line, most useful first. With Expand yes,
the first eligible route is executed without another selection call, within the budget.
**Expand:** yes or no, and why.
**Status:** partial
Use answered only if this page supplies all requested facts, partial for useful
incomplete evidence, or not_found with a brief reason. During navigation, call
web_fetch or reply DONE.

# HU Leadership

Guided by our leadership in administration, faculty, and staff, Harrisburg University excels as a leader in STEM education, bringing our mission to life.

## President’s Cabinet

The President’s Cabinet brings together experienced leaders from across the institution, each contributing deep expertise and distinct perspectives to advance our mission and support the president’s vision for Harrisburg University’s future.
